Bounds reuse the v0.6 sensitivity grid (src/eq_biodt/v03/planning.py:parameter_ensemble) and the v0.5 cross-desert transfer grid (reproducibility/v05/external_transfer.py:CANDIDATES) where defined; remaining parameters carry explicit modeller-assumption bounds.
